propositions: The extra_tools field in runner.py is live (wired via completion_recovery and runs.py; tested in test_completion_banking.py:491) but documented as 'always None in practice'; the stale comment must be corrected in place, not the field deleted.

Three sites in runner.py assert Anthropic 400s on extended-thinking + native-output-constraint, contradicting structured.py:228-238 which labels that rationale stale; the real gate (native_structured_output && (not thinking || native_output_with_thinking)) must be reconciled and documented.

The web-search capability security posture block (capabilities.py:166-198) is a complete ADR with BLOCKING-gate logic and three numbered bounds but exists only as an inline comment with no corresponding ADR in the corpus; it must be extracted into a new ADR (>= 0063).

The AWS-cost capability matrix (capabilities.py:295-316) and rejected-alternative warning (capabilities.py:269-281) are measured facts and anti-refactor guards that must remain verbatim (DO_NOT_MOVE).
providers.py:3-16 duplicates ADR 0059 §1 verbatim including citations; this duplication must be collapsed to a one-line citation.
runner.py at 797/800 lines with a 371-line C901-maxed method has ~45 lines recoverable from comment rationalization; the shard must stay under capacity without behavioral change.
